description: This file contains unit tests for the PemReader class in the org.eclipse.hono.config package. It verifies reading PEM-encoded certificates and keys, handling various formats and error conditions.

classes.name: PemReaderTest
classes.description: Unit test class for PemReader, testing various scenarios for reading PEM-encoded data, including successful reads and error handling.

methods.name: testCertPemPkcs8
methods.description: Verifies PemReader can correctly read a PKCS8 encoded certificate PEM file.

methods.name: testKeyPemPkcs8
methods.description: Verifies PemReader can correctly read a PKCS8 encoded private key PEM file.

methods.name: testKeyPemPkcs1Private
methods.description: Verifies PemReader can correctly read a PKCS1 encoded private key PEM file.

methods.name: testKeyPemPkcs1Public
methods.description: Verifies PemReader can correctly read a PKCS1 encoded public key PEM file.

methods.name: testEmpty
methods.description: Ensures PemReader returns an empty list when reading an empty PEM file.

methods.name: testError1
methods.description: Tests that PemReader throws IOException on invalid payload with bogus data.

methods.name: testError2
methods.description: Tests that PemReader throws IOException when a PEM file is missing an END statement.

methods.name: testError3
methods.description: Tests that PemReader throws IOException when a PEM file only contains an END statement.

methods.name: testError4
methods.description: Tests that PemReader throws IOException when a PEM file contains duplicate BEGIN statements.

methods.name: testError5
methods.description: Tests that PemReader throws IOException when a PEM file is missing a BEGIN statement.
